segments.text: This hole is nine problems away from a fallout shelter.
segments.visualIntent: Plain hole in the cutaway at frame 0; Tuck beside it with a shovel.

segments.text: But fallout is radioactive dust, and it falls straight in. So we add a roof.
segments.visualIntent: Red specks drift into the open hole; plank roof drops on. FIX 1/9.

segments.text: But a thin roof barely stops radiation. So we pile three feet of packed dirt on top.
segments.visualIntent: Red rays pass through roof; dirt mound rises; 3 FT stat callout. FIX 2/9.

segments.text: But dirt is heavy, and the roof starts to sag. So we brace it with thick timber beams.
segments.visualIntent: Roof bows with problem jolt; timber posts and beams drop in. FIX 3/9.

segments.text: But now there's no way in. So we dig an entrance that turns a sharp corner. Radiation hates corners. Preppers call it a baffle entry.
segments.visualIntent: Tuck stuck outside; L-shaped tunnel appears; term tag BAFFLE ENTRY. FIX 4/9.

segments.text: But sealed underground, the air goes stale fast. So we add a hand-cranked fan and a filtered vent pipe.
segments.visualIntent: Stale-air badge; vent pipe rises to surface, crank fan, teal air arrows. FIX 5/9.

segments.text: But you'll be down here a while. So we stock water: one gallon per person, per day.
segments.visualIntent: Empty shelf; water jugs pop on; 1 GAL/DAY stat. FIX 6/9.

segments.text: But what goes in must come out. So we add a lidded bucket toilet and plenty of bags.
segments.visualIntent: Tuck worry pose; bucket toilet with lid drops in corner. FIX 7/9.

segments.text: But it's pitch black. So we hang battery lanterns. Not candles, they eat your air.
segments.visualIntent: Night background swap; lanterns with mustard glow discs. FIX 8/9.

segments.text: But you can't hear the outside world. So we add a hand-crank radio. That's why the official advice is: get inside, stay inside, stay tuned.
segments.visualIntent: Silent question badge; crank radio on shelf; term tag STAY TUNED. FIX 9/9.

segments.text: And here's the surprise: fallout fades fast. After seven hours, it's ten times weaker. After two days, a hundred times.
segments.visualIntent: Red specks on the surface thin out; stat callouts 7 HRS ÷10, 2 DAYS ÷100.

segments.text: Nine problems. Nine fixes. One hole, ready for two weeks.
segments.visualIntent: Static pull-back of the whole lit shelter, Tuck cheer inside.
READY stamp thuds onto the build; end-card disclaimer.
